Kuvitus: suurjännitelinja peltomaiseman: Illustration: a high-voltage line above a field landscape on a summer day. Wires hang between two lattice pylons, and four small birds sit in a row on one wire. In the background are the edge of a forest and a rolling field.
Kaavakuva haarautumispisteestä, ei mitta: Schematic of a junction, not to scale. From the left a current I1 = 0.30 A arrives along a wire at the junction. Two branches leave it: the upper branch has a 30 ohm resistor and the lower branch a 60 ohm resistor, and the branches join again on the right. The width of the purple current arrows is proportional to the current: in the upper branch I2 = 0.20 A, in the lower branch I3 = 0.10 A, and together the branches carry away as much current as arrives at the junction, 0.30 A.

Schematic of a junction, not to scale. From the left a current I1 = 0.30 A arrives along a wire at the junction. Two branches leave it: the upper branch has a 30 ohm resistor and the lower branch a 60 ohm resistor, and the branches join again on the right. The currents of the branches are not marked; a question mark is in their place.
Kytkentäkaavio, ei mittakaavassa: jännit: Circuit diagram, not to scale: a voltage source of 9.0 V, from its positive terminal a resistor R1 = 10 ohms and after it two parallel resistors R2 = 30 ohms and R3 = 60 ohms, which return to the negative terminal of the source. The points A–F are marked on the wires with their potentials when the negative terminal of the source is the zero point: A 9.0 V, B and C 6.0 V, and D, E and F 0 V. At all points of the same wire the potential is the same; it changes only in the source and the resistors.

Circuit diagram, not to scale: a voltage source of 9.0 V, from its positive terminal a resistor R1 = 10 ohms and after it two parallel resistors R2 = 30 ohms and R3 = 60 ohms, which return to the negative terminal of the source. The points A–F are marked on the wires: A right after the positive terminal, B and C after the resistor R1, D and E below the resistors R2 and R3, and F on the wire of the negative terminal. The black lead of the voltmeter is attached to the wire of the negative terminal, and the red lead is free to touch different points. The potentials are not marked.
Potentiaalikuvaaja, pystyakseli mittakaa: Potential graph, vertical axis to scale, horizontal axis schematic: potential V in volts as the loop of the circuit in the figure is traversed from the negative terminal F of the source through the source and the resistors R1 and R2 back to F. In the source the potential rises from 0 volts to 9.0 volts. Along the wire to the point A it stays at 9.0 volts, in the resistor R1 it drops by 3.0 V to 6.0 volts at the point B, and in the resistor R2 from 6.0 V to zero at the point E. From the point E to the point F the potential stays at zero. The sum of the rises and drops is zero.

Potential graph, vertical axis to scale, horizontal axis schematic: a series connection with a voltage source and three resistors R1, R2 and R3. Potential V in volts, grid spacing 1 V. At the negative terminal of the source the potential is 0 V, and in the source it rises to 9 volts at the point A. In the resistor R1 it drops to the value 7 V at the point B, in the resistor R2 to the value 3 V at the point C, and in the resistor R3 to zero at the point D.
Kytkentäkaavio: 6,0 voltin jännitelähde,: Circuit diagram: a 6.0 volt voltage source with an ammeter in its main wire. Two resistors are connected in parallel to the source, R2 = 20 ohms and R3 = 30 ohms. The reading of the ammeter is not marked.
Kytkentäkaavio: 12 voltin jännitelähde,: Circuit diagram: a 12 volt voltage source, in the main wire an ammeter that shows 0.20 A, and a resistor R1 = 40 ohms. After it, in parallel, a resistor R2 = 60 ohms and a resistor R3 whose resistance is not known.
